hooks.command:
current=$(gh api user --jq .login 2>/dev/null)
if [[ "$current" != "aiKrice" ]]; then
  gh auth switch -h github.com -u aiKrice >/dev/null 2>&1
  jq -n --arg cur "${current:-none}" '{systemMessage: ("gh active account is \($cur), not aiKrice. Ran gh auth switch -u aiKrice to fix the stored default, but if GITHUB_TOKEN is exported in your shell it overrides this - run: source ./gh-login.sh in your terminal before ./publish.sh.")}'
fi
exit 0

FILE=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); if [[ "$(basename -- "$FILE" 2>/dev/null)" == "publish.sh" ]]; then ROOT=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd); bash "$ROOT/publish_test.sh"; fi; exit 0
